log.msg: claude -p JSON shape confirmed: result, session_id, total_cost_usd, usage{input_tokens,cache_creation_input_tokens,cache_read_input_tokens,output_tokens}, duration_ms. COST: default Claude Code system prompt = $0.060/image (46k cache read of skills+CLAUDE.md every call). With --setting-sources "" --system-prompt <one constant line> --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections --strict-mcp-config, steady state is $0.015-0.030/image — 4x cheaper. First call pays $0.13 to warm the cache, then cache_creation drops to 0. The system prompt must be byte-identical on every call or the cache is cold every time.

assign.now: cost model measured; writing prompts + run.mjs

log.msg: --dry estimate for the Sonnet pass: <= 90 shots, <= $2.70 (6 pages x 3 widths x (1 page + <=4 regions)). All six pages return 200. /framework/web/ yields 0 regions at 1280 and 3440 - it is prose with nothing framed/flex/grid inside the size gates; its page shot still gets analyzed.

--model fable IS accepted by the CLI. It is expensive: a trivial text turn cost $0.41, all of it a cold 19,216-token cache write at Fables 1h rate. Warm it costs ~$0.15/image. Three shots is the right ceiling. Region picker rebuilt after measuring: probe default depth (12 cut the cards off /framework/ui/ entirely), region must be <= 35% of viewport area AND <= 1.2x viewport height (a .page scroll box is 1051x4423 - one image six times the price of the page), framed boxes first, at most 2 per selector. 70 shots captured across 6 pages x 3 widths.

PILOT LANDED. vision.jsonl = 76 lines / 71 pngs. sonnet 70 shots $5.05 (avg $0.072), opus 3 $0.59 (avg $0.195), fable 3 $0.96 (avg $0.321) - total $6.60. 308+12+16 findings, 114 broken. THE COST MODEL IS NOT WHAT THE PROPOSAL ASSUMED: a region crop costs the same as a whole page ($0.068 vs $0.087), because cost is the models ~2000-token answer plus a fixed 40k cache read, not the image area. Shoot fewer better regions; a crop is not cheap. Spot-check PASSES: div.ai-card.surface @390 - the prose names the truncated migra..., the 2px green rule, the 0/7 counter and the orphaned opus-5, all visible in that exact crop.

assign.outcome:
**A headless vision runner, and the first real corpus it produced: 76 analyzed shots for $6.60.**

`ext/DesignTool/vision/run.mjs` shoots a page and its regions at any width, asks one **fresh** claude session per image, and appends one line per shot as it goes — shot, region box, prompt id, model, session id, tokens, cost, prose, findings (`broken` | `maybe`). `--dry` prices a run before it costs anything, `--resume-run` restarts a crashed one, `--turn2 css-v1` resumes each image own session for a `{sel, decl}` that `audit/twin.js` already knows how to render.

- [The runner + prompts](/framework/ext/DesignTool/vision/) — `run.mjs`, `readme.md`, and the three prompts kept **in the repo**: `prompts/critique-v1.md`, `prompts/critique-full-v1.md`, `prompts/css-v1.md`. Every run also writes `prompts.json` beside its log, so a run reads on its own.
- [The pilot run](/framework/ai/2026-08-17/vision-pilot/) — 6 pages x 390/1280/3440, whole page then <=4 regions. **76 lines, 71 pngs, 336 findings (114 broken), $6.60.** sonnet 70 shots $5.05 (avg $0.072) - opus 3 $0.59 (avg $0.195) - fable 3 $0.96 (avg $0.321), the same three 1280 images through all three so they can be compared.

![](/framework/ai/2026-08-17/vision-pilot/shots/c2560e8970d9c2c6.png)

Spot-check on that crop (`div.ai-card.surface` @390, sonnet): the prose names the truncated `migra...`, the 2px green rule that barely reads as a progress bar, the `0/7` counter and the unlabelled `opus-5` — every one of them visible in that exact image, nothing invented.

**The cost model is not what the proposal assumed.** A region crop costs the same as a whole page ($0.068 vs $0.087): the bill is the model ~2,000-token answer plus a fixed 40k cache read, not the image area. Shoot fewer, better regions. And `SYSTEM` in `run.mjs` is the prompt-cache key — constant it is cheap, edited every call pays a cold write, omitted it costs ~$0.06 because the CLI default re-reads 46k of skills and CLAUDE.md per image.

Left: the browse page (`page.js`/`browse.js`/`vision.css`, sibling agent) and `DesignTool/page.js` `children:` naming `vision` — until then the module has no url. No `--turn2` pass over the pilot (budget); it is tested, not run at scale. `/framework/web/` yields 0 regions at 1280 and 3440 — prose with nothing framed inside the size gates.

log.msg: Two bugs fixed in run.mjs after the vision-prompts experiment hit them. (1) prompts.json now MERGES with what is already in the out dir - it used to overwrite, so a second run under a different prompt erased the first ones text and left those log lines pointing at a prompt_id that resolved to nothing. (2) --resume-run keyed on the png hash alone, so re-asking the same image under a new prompt or model was wrongly skipped and produced an empty run that looked like a success; the key is now hash|prompt_id|model. asked() is a hoisted function declaration, not a const - seen() runs during mains synchronous prefix, before a const at that line would be initialised (the same TDZ trap that bit chromium()). Verified: identical ask -> 0 shots $0.00; new prompt on the same png -> asked; prompts.json kept all five keys. Also folded Mikes UX ask into prompts/critique-full-v2.md as two angles (purpose: what is this page FOR, is the current/active thing first; overview and drill-down: everything at once or a slice, and is there an obvious way further in). v1 stays the default until v2 is compared. ux-v1.md left to day-page-ux.
